name: playwright-ai-framework
description: AI-powered self-healing Playwright framework: write requirements → AI generates tests → tests self-heal on failure

scripts.postinstall:
npx playwright install chromium && bash scripts/install-shell-commands.sh && printf '
\033[1;32m✓ Setup complete!\033[0m

Activate now (one time):

  source ~/.zshrc

Then from any terminal:
  pfqa run login tests
  pfqa list all tests
  run login tests headed
'
scripts.report:generate: JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS='-Xmx16g' npx allure-commandline generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.report:share: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),d='allure-results';fs.readdirSync(d).filter(f=>f.endsWith('-attachment')||f.match(/\.(webm|zip)$/)).forEach(f=>fs.unlinkSync(path.join(d,f)));" && JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS='-Xmx16g' npx allure-commandline generate --single-file allure-results --clean -o allure-report-share && echo 'Share: allure-report-share/index.html'
